name: Demo — 2015 Ukraine Electric Power Attack
description: Demo scenario inspired by the publicly documented 2015 Ukraine electric power attack. Enterprise behaviors and contextual reconnaissance are enriched for matrix visualization; this is not an authoritative incident reconstruction or an ICS ATT&CK layer.

layers.name: EXT-TARGET
layers.description: External targeting layer for researching victim domains, personnel, software, and business relationships around critical infrastructure operators.

layers.name: DMZ-MAIL
layers.description: Mail boundary where targeted messages and malicious Office attachments are delivered to the enterprise.

layers.name: INT-ENDPOINT
layers.description: Internal user endpoint layer where the attachment is opened, script execution begins, and additional payloads are transferred.

techniques.comment: Additional payload transfer remains unconfirmed at the endpoint layer.

layers.name: INT-NETWORK
layers.description: Internal network layer for executing related components, discovering systems, capturing credentials from traffic, and reaching operational access paths.

layers.name: INT-OT
layers.description: Internal operational technology layer representing enterprise-visible preparation and disruptive effects while retaining Enterprise ATT&CK identifiers only.

techniques.comment: File deletion is marked seen in the operational-technology impact context.
